Ash Wednesday. Lent. Easter. The Hallow app. Super Bowl commercials. Celebrity endorsements. What is really happening and why are so many evangelical Christians suddenly embracing traditions that were once considered distinctly Catholic?

Let's unpack the explosive rise of Ash Wednesday and Lent across Protestant churches, mainstream media, and Hollywood culture, examining whether these 40 days of fasting, prayer, and penance are truly biblical or rooted in ancient pagan ritual. From Mark Wahlberg and Jonathan Roumie promoting Lent to the viral growth of the Hallow prayer app, to Whoopi Goldberg praising Pope Francis, to Protestant networks discussing Ash Wednesday on air — the cultural shift is undeniable.

Tracing history back to Constantine, pagan Rome, Mystery Babylon, and the prophetic symbolism of Revelation 13 and 17, this message challenges viewers to examine whether modern Christianity is blending biblical faith with tradition, ritual, and man-made commandments.
